result.topic_en: The page derives continued fractions for the k-th roots of e of the form e^{1/k}/(e^{1/k}-1), then states and solves Problem V: converting the general alternating series s = ax/(αy) − abx²/(αβy²) + … into a continued fraction.
result.transcription:

$= \frac{x e^{\frac{x}{y}}}{e^{\frac{x}{y}}-1}$, vnde obtinebuntur sequentes formulae speciales: sumendo $x=1$ et loco $y$ successiue numeros 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 etc.
$\frac{e}{e-1} = 1 + \cfrac{1}{1+\cfrac{2}{2+\cfrac{3}{3+\text{etc.}}}}$
$\frac{\sqrt{e}}{\sqrt{e}-1} = 2 + \cfrac{2}{3+\cfrac{4}{5+\cfrac{6}{7+\text{etc.}}}}$
$\frac{\sqrt[3]{e}}{\sqrt[3]{e}-1} = 3 + \cfrac{3}{5+\cfrac{6}{8+\cfrac{9}{11+\text{etc.}}}}$
$\frac{\sqrt[4]{e}}{\sqrt[4]{e}-1} = 4 + \cfrac{4}{7+\cfrac{8}{11+\cfrac{12}{15+\text{etc.}}}}$
Problema V.
Si in genere proposita fuerit series huius formae:
$s = \frac{ax}{\alpha y} - \frac{abx^2}{\alpha\beta y^2} + \frac{abcx^3}{\alpha\beta\gamma y^3} - \frac{abcdx^4}{\alpha\beta\gamma\delta y^4} + \text{etc.}$

) 169 (
eam in fractionem continuam conuertere.
Solutio.
§. 50. Ex serie proposita formemus sequentes:
$t = \frac{bx}{\beta y} - \frac{bcx^2}{\beta\gamma y^2} + \frac{bcdx^3}{\beta\gamma\delta y^3} - \frac{bcdex^4}{\beta\gamma\delta\epsilon y^4} + \text{etc.}$ et
$u = \frac{cx}{\gamma y} - \frac{cdx^2}{\gamma\delta y^2} + \frac{cdex^3}{\gamma\delta\epsilon y^3} - \frac{cdefx^4}{\gamma\delta\epsilon\zeta y^4} + \text{etc.}$
ita vt sit $s = \frac{ax}{\alpha y}(1-t)$ hincque
$\frac{ax}{s} = \frac{\alpha y}{1-t} = \alpha y + \frac{\alpha y t}{1-t}$.
Est vero
$\frac{\alpha y t}{1-t} = \frac{\alpha y}{-1+\frac{1}{t}} = \frac{\alpha b x y}{-bx+\frac{bx}{t}}$
vnde fit
$\frac{ax}{s} = \alpha y + \frac{\alpha bxy}{-bx+\frac{bx}{t}}$;
simili igitur modo ex relatione $\frac{bx}{\beta y}(1-u)$ fiet
$\frac{bx}{t} = \beta y + \frac{\beta cxy}{-cx+\frac{cx}{u}}$
sicque porro. Quare his valoribus continuo substitutis orietur ista fractio continua:
$\frac{ax}{s} = \alpha y + \cfrac{\alpha bxy}{\beta y - bx + \cfrac{\beta cxy}{\gamma y - cx + \cfrac{\gamma dxy}{\delta y - dx + \text{etc.}}}}$
hinc sequens

items.english: If in general a series of this form is proposed: s = ax/(αy) − abx²/(αβy²) + abcx³/(αβγy³) − abcdx⁴/(αβγδy⁴) + etc., to convert it into a continued fraction.
